<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission controversy:</strong> The Congress party is organizing nationwide agitations and internal meetings to protest against the Election Commission, amid growing international and domestic scrutiny regarding electoral integrity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxQU0Q1SlNsVXJjdFdFQTgxTHlOY1k1RF9WUlR1NkkwV1V2YmxZT2lSRmpYUVpDbTFrQW9mc3hRZ0RWVzNUenE1OHlzandMRFJSZUFsekI4NkFtY3ZHS2swbDlqMjVrZmFxdXprYWQwLUQyc2RJdl9OZkR5WVVyNGlvVXMxb2lleWhkdlhnX1ExaHdvZlBNNFpnNjZfOA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi__?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judiciary and parliamentary panels:</strong> Supreme Court judges have declined to appear before a parliamentary panel discussing the &quot;one-nation, one-election&quot; proposal, highlighting ongoing tensions regarding the separation of powers.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election integrity and legal challenges:</strong> The Election Commission has ordered a special drive to address voter exclusion in 20 states, even as the BJP and Congress trade accusations over the handling of constitutional bodies and electoral conduct.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative and judicial accountability:</strong> A BJP MP faces a legal challenge in the Rajya Sabha over alleged non-disclosure of criminal records, while the Supreme Court continues to adjudicate on high-profile political and criminal cases.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
